newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher on arbitrage-buying.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher on arbitrage-buying.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed higher on Thursday, buoyed by technical buying linked with futures trading. Brokers said that the market was off a temporary bottom, but investors were not confident of the market's energy amid a lack of buying factors.
The key Nikkei 225 average powered up 166.10 points or 0.79 percent to close at 21,322.85. Its December futures added 120 points to 21,320.
"The market is currently driven by supply and demand balance in the futures market," said Keiji Arai, strategist at Sanyo Securities Co Ltd.
And also after the market closed, Nomura Securities Co Ltd announced it would hold a news conference at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) on support for its unit Nomura Finance Co Ltd.
The second section index was down 1.40 points or 0.07 percent at 2,106.61, with 10.53 million shares traded.
The over-the-counter (OTC) index eased 0.01 points to close at 1,570.93.
